mapper.select: select count(1) from lab_reservation
select count(1) from lab_reservation where status = '已通过'
select count(1) from lab_reservation where status in ('待审核', '冲突')
select count(1) from usage_record
select count(1) from usage_record where remark like concat('%', '预约编号', '%')
select count(1) from usage_record where status = '异常'
select count(1) from repair_order
select count(1) from repair_order where description like concat('%', '使用记录#', '%')
select count(1) from repair_order where status in ('待派单', '处理中', '待验收')
select count(1) from repair_order where status in ('已完成', '已关闭')
select count(1) from device
select count(1) from device where status = '正常'
select count(1) from device where status = '维护中'
select count(1) from device where status = '故障'
select count(1) from course_environment_request
select count(1) from course_environment_request where process_status = '已确认' or confirm_status = '已确认'
select count(1) from environment_template
select count(1) from consumable_inventory
select count(1) from consumable_inventory where tag_type in ('danger', 'warning') or stock <= warn_threshold
select count(1) from notice
select count(1) from notice where publish_status = '已发布'
select count(1) from module_record where module_name = 'operation-events'
select date_format(use_time, '%m-%d') as name, count(1) as value from usage_record where use_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date_format(use_time, '%m-%d') order by min(use_time)

select coalesce(l.lab_code, resource) as name, count(1) as value from usage_record ur left join lab l on ur.resource = l.lab_name or ur.resource = concat(l.lab_code, ' ', l.lab_name) group by coalesce(l.lab_code, resource) order by value desc limit 8
select coalesce(nullif(fault_type, ''), '未分类') as name, count(1) as value from repair_order group by coalesce(nullif(fault_type, ''), '未分类') order by value desc limit 8
select record_json from module_record where module_name = 'operation-events' order by id desc limit #{limit}
